options.content: **These are live-sampled, reference-free metrics** from `app/eval/jobs/online_eval.py` scoring `ONLINE_EVAL_SAMPLE_RATE` of real traffic with the lexical judge (no ground truth available on live traffic, no GPU judge call — see the module docstring). They are a drift signal, not a substitute for the gated CI gold-set suite (`app/eval/thresholds.yaml`, recall@5/MRR/nDCG/faithfulness-with-ground-truth), which only runs in `eval-gate.yml` against the curated gold set. Both empty/flat panels usually mean `ONLINE_EVAL_ENABLED`/`ONLINE_EVAL_SAMPLE_RATE` are unset (both default off) or `PROMETHEUS_ENABLED` is false.

options.content: **These come from `eval-gate.yml`'s `tier2-full-suite`** — the real Qwen2.5-7B-judge numbers `thresholds.yaml` actually gates on (`retrieval` is enforced; the rest are informational until re-baselined — see the header comment in `thresholds.yaml`), pushed to Prometheus Pushgateway after every post-deploy and manually-dispatched Tier-2 run (not on every PR — Tier-1 has no network path to this box and scores an ephemeral checkout, not the production container; see `.github/workflows/eval-gate.yml`'s comment on the push step). Values persist between runs (Pushgateway semantics) — a flat line between two points is real, not a gap in scraping.

panels.title: Retrieval quality — recall@5 / recall@10 / hit_rate (CI Tier-2, GATED)
panels.description: Gate floors (thresholds.yaml, v5 production baseline): recall@5 >= 0.4835, recall@10 >= 0.5259, hit_rate >= 0.6447. A breach here is what triggers eval-gate.yml's auto-rollback (see docs/runbooks/phase-31-monitoring.md §6) — this panel should visually confirm what the job log already said, not be the first place you learn about it.

panels.title: Retrieval ranking quality — MRR / nDCG@10 / context_precision (CI Tier-2, GATED)
panels.description: Gate floors: MRR >= 0.3380, nDCG@10 >= 0.3823, context_precision >= 0.0255 — context_precision's absolute value is low by design (thresholds.yaml flags it as a known future retrieval-quality target, not a bug in this panel).

panels.title: Generation quality — faithfulness / answer_relevancy / context_recall (CI Tier-2, informational)
panels.description: NOT gated — thresholds.yaml keeps `generation` informational-only pending re-baseline on the current judge (see its header comment). Real judge (Qwen2.5-7B, app/eval/judges/qwen_judge.py), unlike the lexical faithfulness panel above.

panels.title: Hallucination rate — real judge (CI Tier-2, informational)
panels.description: thresholds.yaml gate ceiling: max 0.72 (not currently enforced — hallucination stays informational, only retrieval gates). Compare against the live-sampled panel above: same detector (hallucination_flag_single), different traffic — this is the curated gold set, that one is sampled production traffic.

panels.title: Last Tier-2 push age
panels.description: Yellow past 2 days, red past 7 — Tier-2 only runs post-deploy and (once enabled) nightly, so this is expected to sit in the hours-to-a-day range on an active release cadence, not near-zero like a scrape-based metric.
